description: Matthew Kuhn's unofficial ascelike class v3.0 (2025/03/17, CTAN and MiKTeX package ascelike, LPPL 1.1 or later), the ASCE journal and proceedings manuscript format; ASCE's official Overleaf template uses ascelike-new.cls, derived from it and not in MiKTeX. Journal is the class default and the mode of ASCE's official template: article at 12pt, one column, letter paper, double spaced (setspace) with line numbers (lineno), both loaded at \begin{document}. The bundle's example uses Proceedings instead (single spaced, no line numbers). The class loads babel (american), newtxtext, newtxmath, microtype and authblk itself; under XeTeX newtxtext sets TeX Gyre Termes X through fontspec. It needs nothing in the preamble: without biblatex it keeps its own BibTeX \cite code for ascelike.bst and only writes a note to the log (ascelike.cls l.777-781); with biblatex it passes style=ascelike and backend=biber (l.652).
